name: faceted mug
caption: A faceted mug with four flat faces, a square rim and one angular handle. Four flat walls rise from a sealed base; one squared handle joins two faces. Faceted walls keep a constant thickness and the handle opening passes through. Overall width is 1.00 times depth; height is 0.82 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous cream, dark brown, charcoal color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
